summary: A browser game where you have to use up resources while responding to real space weather event which is technically a text based game. The choice that you pick will use up the resource that you have. By putting players in charge of a 10-Sol Mars outpost where every engineering choice has a real trade-off. Players work alongside crew members Yuzu and Riko to balance Power, Oxygen, Food, and Radiation Shielding during realistic crises like solar flares and dust storms. Its important because it turns intimidating space science into something anyone can understand and play in seconds.
details:
Well, my game is a browser game which is about choosing a one out of two choices which use your resource to survive the mission which is through 10-Sol which also depends on your difficulty. The resource that have to be reminded are Power, Oxygen, Food and Radiation Shielding. as Solar storms, dust events and habitat emergencies strike, player have to decide option a or b which carry realistic resource trade off like i said before.

For the benefit, Isolated Orbit turns complex astronaut surival into a hands on problem solving. Every in-game event give you a real NASA science fact which is taken from NASA datasets and resources which was provided in the challenge page. Which help students or even player understands.

For the game, it was built with Kiro AI for the development of the game and also it was used as research assistant to help structure the web dashboard, code as well as the facts from the official NASA challenge resource. The concept was my idea as well as the mechanics but i couldn't do it alone and its quite difficult so i decided to ask Kiro AI to improve it and make it simpler. The game is also built with HTML, CSS as well as JavaScript and is hosted using GitHub.

Since i wanted to add a bit of creativity i try to add a bit story, even if it isn't really the finish product. Character like Yuzu and Riko is added to make the game atleast a bit engaging since its just a text based game for now. To make it unique, i also make sure that hard and expert have more event that will occur in the game rather then being the same with easy and normal. It might be difficult but who is to say that it be easy.

Since i have no teammates, technically none.
